newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 91-day T-bill rate to rise - poll. [CORRECTED 05:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Philippine 91-day T-bill rate to rise - poll. [CORRECTED 05:10 GMT]

text.p: The Philippine benchmark 91-day Treasury bill rate is seen rising to 11.375 percent in the weekly auction today from last week's 10.617 (corrects figure from 10.822) percent, a Reuters poll of four financial institutions showed.
Higher T-bill rates are expected after the Central Bank raised its key overnight borrowing rate by a total of 8.75 percentage points to 20 percent last Thursday and Friday to quell peso speculation.
